answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 31418 Country: Bangladesh Title: Touching sister in law with lust Question: Assalaamu Alaikum wa Rahmatullaahi wa Barakaatuhu ! Once my wife’s menses period, I closed to her and done kissing and others except intercourse (I knew that intercourse is strictly prohibited during menses period) and that I felt exciting. After 3 or 4 hours later I grasped /took held of my sister in law (wife‘s sister), she read in class two, age approximately below nine. During that time, when I picking up him, my hand touched her breast and other shame places (note that no physical sign in her body as sex attraction) and that I felt exiting also and I took down him at that time. Few times later, I bow out my urine in the latrine and found moni with urine. Considering the above facts, Please tell me, any effects is to my marriage status under the Islamic Shariah? Jazakallah Kharian Answer ID: 31418 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 686/686/M=1432) Your nikah with your wife is intact. Your wife did not become haram due to touching the sister-in-law, but you should observe extra care in order to avoid such acts in future. Distance yourself from her and do not make her sleep close to you. You should repent to Allah and ask for His forgiveness. Also, one should not indulge in sexual activities with wife between navel to knee in menstruation without a cover. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
